planner.title: 📅 Weekly planner
planner.emptyBody: Every skill you can do with your gear is finished, or needs gear you don't have yet. Add gear in Settings or find new skills in Discover.
planner.why1: Under 5 hours a week: the plan never goes over the budget.
planner.why2: One combo a week: a craft skill + a software skill in one clip, finishing both Produce quests together.
planner.why3: One craft quest + one or two software quests, then the skills nearest to mastery fill what is left.
planner.why4: Never two Produce quests on the same day; heavy work sits mid-week (Mon–Wed), light work on Sat and Fri.
planner.why5: The plan is fixed for the week: it only changes when your progress or gear changes.
planner.manualSoon: Adding and removing items by hand arrives in the next round.
